name: Fundamental Quality Filter
description: Regime gate that filters symbols based on fundamental quality. Checks survivability score, revenue growth, profitability, debt levels, and free cash flow. Use this to run A/B experiments: same technical strategy with and without a fundamental gate to measure whether fundamentals improve signal quality.
author: system

tunable_params.label: Min Survivability Score
tunable_params.description: Minimum composite survivability score (0-100). Higher = stricter quality gate. Set to 0 to disable.

tunable_params.label: Require Positive Revenue Growth
tunable_params.description: Revenue (YoY) must be growing. Filters out shrinking businesses.

tunable_params.label: Require Profitability
tunable_params.description: Net profit margin must be > 0. Enable to restrict to profitable companies only.

tunable_params.label: Max Debt / Equity
tunable_params.description: Maximum debt-to-equity ratio. Set to 0 to disable this check.

tunable_params.label: Min Tactical Score
tunable_params.description: Minimum tactical grade score (0-100). Combines momentum, positioning, and catalyst signals. Set to 0 to disable.

tunable_params.label: Require Positive Free Cash Flow
tunable_params.description: Free cash flow (TTM) must be positive. Enable for cash-generative businesses only.
